artworks.title: The Landing of the Troops
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 14 × 37.7 cm (5 1/2 × 14 13/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image is seen from a high angle, showing a scene with people and ships on a beach, with the sea in the distance. The horizon is about two-thirds up the image, lined with sailing ships. The central area is framed with ornamental scrollwork, resembling decorative fabric drapes. The style is like an etching or engraving with precise lines and crosshatching for texture. The color palette is black and white. Close to us, inside the frame, figures are engaged in activities, with groups near the shore and boats docking. The scene extends further to show more people and structures, forming a busy tableau that progresses to the horizon.

artworks.title: Il Capitano, or L'Innamorato
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 22.2 × 15.3 cm (8 3/4 × 6 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing upright and in a commanding position. He has a prominent nose, a long mustache, and curly hair flowing from beneath a large, feathered cap. The man is wearing a detailed outfit with a collared, long-sleeved tunic featuring decorative buttons, a belt around the waist, fitted lower garment, and boots. He is holding a book in his right hand and has a sword by his side. The background features a lively city scene with numerous buildings and a crowd of people in the streets. Some individuals are talking, and a couple is dancing in the vibrant atmosphere.

artworks.title: Pantalone
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 24.3 × 15.6 cm (9 9/16 × 6 1/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a tall, thin man in profile from head to feet, bending slightly forward. He has one hand on his chest and the other hanging at his side. The man has a prominent nose and chin, angular facial features, medium-length hair, and a goatee. He is wearing a long cloak over a belted tunic and leggings, with a broad-brimmed hat. The background features Renaissance-style buildings, smaller figures, and people on balconies.

artworks.title: Zanni
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 24 × 15.5 cm (9 7/16 × 6 1/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a person with a sword in their right hand, standing with their body slightly turned. They have distinctive facial features, a long, curled mustache, and are wearing a large hat with plumes. The person is dressed in loose-fitting clothing, including a long-sleeved top, baggy pants, and shoes. They are surrounded by an urban backdrop with detailed buildings, balconies, and smaller figures in the background.

artworks.title: Reading Beneath the Trees (La Lecture sous les arbres)
artworks.description: The image depicts a group of trees dominating the scene, viewed from a low angle. The horizon is not clearly visible, with faint structures atop a hill in the distance. The sketchy and impressionistic brushstrokes create a textured effect, with sparse lines suggesting leaves for movement. The color palette is monochromatic, featuring blacks and grays on a beige or light cream background, lending a subdued atmosphere. Several tall, slender trees with sparse branches are closest, set against a darker shaded ground, with the landscape sloping upwards beyond.

artworks.title: Philip Melanchton, Half-Length to the Left, Standing Behind a Breastwork
artworks.description: The image shows a man in a half-body depiction. He is facing slightly to the right, with his head turned directly toward the viewer. Both of his hands are visible; one hand is positioned across his chest, holding a ring at waist level. The man's facial features are distinct, with pronounced lines and an expression of calmness. His hair is short and wavy, covering his head with subtle curls. He is dressed in elaborate attire typical of a scholarly or clerical figure, with a high collared robe featuring wide, voluminous sleeves and folds. The robe is detailed with intricate lines, emphasizing texture and richness. The background is monochromatic and plain, with a small emblem-like mark near his shoulder.

artworks.title: Saint Andrew
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing and reading a book. He has detailed facial features, a long curly beard and mustache, and curly hair forming a halo. He is wearing a long robe, standing barefoot in a natural setting surrounded by tree trunks. The background is simple, emphasizing the man and the trees. The artwork features intricate textures in the man's clothes and surroundings, following a classical art style.

artworks.title: Diogène et Alcibiade a l'Odéon
artworks.description: The image features two figures positioned in a setting suggestive of antiquity. On the left, a bearded man stands gesturing with his right hand while holding a mug in his left. He is dressed in a garment that drapes over his shoulders and reaches his knees. Behind him, a cask or barrel is visible. To his right, another man stands with one hand on his hip, facing him directly. This man has a clean-shaven face with neatly styled hair and is clad in a short tunic adorned with a garland. Behind them, faint figures form a backdrop of onlookers.

artworks.title: Ex-membres de l'ex-société de l'ex-Dix-décembre
artworks.description: The image shows two men seated at a table. One man sits upright on a chair while the other leans forward on a bench. The man on the left has a beard, wavy hair, and wears a jacket over a shirt with striped trousers. The man on the right has tousled hair, a clean-shaven face, and wears a long coat with patterned trousers. On the table between them are a pitcher and two glasses. The background shows a rough sketch of a wall with some shading.

artworks.title: Inconvénient d'acheter un journal...
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a crowd of people reading newspapers. The scene depicts figures holding up newspapers with various expressions. The individuals are dressed in period clothing. The artwork is created with pencil or charcoal, showing a range of grey tones. The crowd is standing on cobblestone pavement, with tall buildings in the background stretching into the horizon. The drawing captures a moment of news dissemination in an urban setting.

artworks.title: L'Eau du puits de Grenelle
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two men examining and drinking from glasses and a jug. The scene depicts one figure on the left, eagerly drinking from a large jug. The figure on the right holds a glass, peering skeptically at its contents. Both figures are styled in a manner typical of 19th-century gentlemen. The surrounding handwritten text in French adds context to the scene.

artworks.title: Le Nouveau pavage en bois... de Paris
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of people engaged in a scene. The image depicts exaggerated interactions between the figures. Two figures on the left appear to be in a struggle, with one grabbing the other's neck. Another person in the middle holds a mop or broom, seemingly caught mid-action, while a figure lying on the ground looks up. The background contains more figures walking past, all wearing period clothing and hats. The drawing is rendered in a style characteristic of caricature, with features and poses exaggerated for effect. The scene is lively, with the artist's lines capturing dynamic movement and emotion among the figures.

artworks.title: Origine des Bédoins a Paris
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures engaged in conversation over a cart. The drawing features two characters in the foreground who appear to be having a discussion; one is standing with hands outspread, while the other is bending forward, gripping the handles of a cart that has a large wheel next to him. The clothing on both individuals is detailed, showing hats and loose-fitting garments. In the background, a few more figures can be seen, but they are less detailed. Above the scene is handwritten text that includes "Actualités." Below the drawing, there is a section of handwritten script. The drawing utilizes careful linework to convey expression and movement, using shading for depth and texture.

artworks.title: Le Conseil de révision
artworks.description: The image displays a group of individuals in various poses. In the center, an elderly man is examining a young shirtless man's mouth. Another older figure stands nearby. To the left, seated and standing individuals watch, including an older woman and a man with folded arms. To the right, a tall officer in a military uniform observes the scene with two other shirtless young men. In the background, additional figures are faintly drawn. The setting seems to be a formal room for examinations or selections.

artworks.title: Le Dernier du Télémaque
artworks.description: The image shows a group of four men and one woman standing on the deck of a ship. The woman is leaning forward while holding onto a barrel or large coil of rope, both hands resting on it. The men, all wearing top hats and coats, stand to her right, with one of them gesturing with a pointing hand. The man in the centre has a prominent fur collar and is looking towards the left side of the image. The woman has her back to the viewer, showing dark, styled hair pulled into an updo. In the background, the sea can be seen stretching into the distance, with a smaller boat carrying two people who appear to be rowing. A mast and some rigging are visible to the right. The composition suggests a moment of observation or interaction involving those on the ship and the smaller boat on the sea. The drawing contains handwritten notes and a border suggesting it may be a draft or unfinished piece.

artworks.title: En Voila un de plaisir!
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a person fishing on an icy surface. The drawing features a figure wearing a formal coat and top hat, standing on patches of ice with a fishing rod extended into a body of water with visible ice flows around them. In the background, there are outlines of architectural structures, which suggest a town or city. The foreground of the drawing shows three-dimensional ice cuts adding depth, and the use of shading brings texture to the coat and the icy surface. Handwritten text adorns the top and bottom of the drawing.

artworks.title: Fallait pas me tutoyer, j'suis dans...
artworks.description: The image shows three men on a cobblestone street. The man on the left stands upright with a surprised expression, disheveled hair, and wearing worn-out clothing. The man in the center is in a crouched position, supporting another man who appears to have collapsed or is sitting on the ground. The third man on the right is slouched or leaning back, possibly fainted or asleep, with a hat beside him. The background features outlines of buildings and trees.

artworks.title: V'la plus de six francs que je perds...
artworks.description: The image shows a woman from the waist up, slightly bent forward as she leans over a table covered with a cloth. Her head is covered with a shawl, her facial expression is detailed with eyes wide open and mouth slightly agape. She wears a long-sleeved garment and a long skirt that reaches her shoes; her attire appears layered, with a shawl or scarf around her shoulders. A jug or container is on the floor beside her feet. The setting is indoors with a tiled floor, a chair behind her, and a window with a grid of square panes visible on the left side, framed by simple walls. A bowl or basket sits underneath the table, and the wall behind her is plain. The background shows no additional details beyond what's described, focusing on the woman and her actions.

artworks.title: Faudra que je vous fasse faire un jour...
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a sculptor working on a piece in their studio. The artist is seated on a wooden crate, shaping a small sculpture on a tabletop. The studio is filled with sculptural elements and a figure is observing the artist's work. The drawing is done in a monochromatic palette with detailed shading.

artworks.title: Eh bonjour! enchanté de vous rencontrer...
artworks.description: The image shows a cartoon-like illustration featuring two figures standing in a pool of water. The person on the left is leaning forward, holding the hands of the person on the right. The figure on the left has long, dark hair, while the other figure has a large belly and is wearing striped swim shorts. Two additional figures are on a wooden platform in the background. The setting appears to be indoors, with plain walls. Handwritten text is present on the illustration.

artworks.title: Les Bains a vingt centimes, nouveau style
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interaction in a prison setting. The foreground shows two figures; one in a striped outfit and hat, gesturing towards another figure who is partially undressed. The setting is sparse with wooden benches, giving a sense of confinement. Another figure is in the background, partially nude. There are handwritten notes and the style suggests a comedic circumstance, emphasizing the absurdity of the scene.

artworks.title: Parole d'honneur Mme. Frenouillet...
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals facing each other. The person on the left holds a cup in each hand and stands on a slightly elevated platform. They have an elongated face with exaggerated features, and their hair is styled in a bun. The person on the right extends a cup towards the other. They have a round face with exaggerated expressions and short hair. The background is a wooden interior with a draped curtain. A table with bottles is at the left, and the floor is wooden. Handwritten text borders the image at the top and sides.

artworks.title: Une élè...zélée travaillant a domicile
artworks.description: The image shows a scene with two people. The first person, a woman, is lying across cushions or a low sofa faced down, with her right arm extended forward and her head turned slightly to the side. She has long, dark hair and is wearing a dress with long sleeves and a full skirt. Her feet in heeled shoes are at the other end of the cushions. To her left, a man is partially visible, standing in the doorway and leaning against the doorframe. He has short, dark hair and is dressed in a shirt and trousers. There is a painting on the wall in the background and an ornate chair to the right. The room is shaded in soft tones.

artworks.title: Ma femme... ça mord... ça mord!
artworks.description: The image is of a man fishing by a riverbank. The man is shown crouching by the water, wearing a wide-brimmed hat, light-colored shirt, dark striped trousers, and shoes. Beside him is a woven basket. In the background, there are two partially visible figures behind a tree, a man and a woman, looking towards the fishing man. The background shows trees creating shade and an open expanse leading to the horizon. There is a handwritten caption in French at the bottom of the drawing.
